instruction: I want Chrome to use a custom search engine as my default instead of Google. How do I change the default search engine?

parameters.command: echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt update -y && echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt install jq -y
cd /home/user/.config/google-chrome/Default && jq '. + {"session":{"restore_on_startup":4, "startup_urls":["http://funbrain.com/"]}}' Preferences > temp && mv temp Preferences

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the default search engine in Chrome settings. Similar complexity - navigate to Settings > Search engine and select a different default. The evaluator checks if default_search_provider_data.template_url_data.short_name is not 'Google'.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Binary: 1.0 if default search engine changed from Google, 0.0 otherwise

Complete coverage: evaluator checks the core requirement of changing default search engine
